neighbours.label: the final piece 'in' of the cytoskeletal motor/filament proteins actin and myosin (act|in, myos|in); other '-in' proteins (insulin, keratin, elastin) and the preposition 'in' stay quiet
fire: Listeria bacteria hijack the host's actin to propel themselves through the cytoplasm.
During cytokinesis a ring of actin and myosin pinches the dividing cell in two.
The drug blocks the assembly of actin filaments near the plasma membrane.
Each sarcomere shortens when myosin slides the thin filaments toward its centre.
Fluorescent phalloidin was used to stain actin in the fixed fibroblasts.
Mutations in cardiac myosin are a common cause of inherited heart disease.
Growth cones steer by remodelling their actin cytoskeleton in response to guidance cues.
Non-muscle myosin generates the tension that closes the wound edge.
quiet: The pancreas releases insulin into the blood after a sugary meal.
Feathers and hooves are built from keratin made by skin cells.
Loss of elastin makes ageing skin sag and wrinkle over time.
Red blood cells are packed with hemoglobin that carries oxygen to tissues.
The stomach secretes pepsin to begin breaking down dietary protein.
Tendons owe their strength to bundles of collagen aligned along the load.
The cells were grown in a dish in the dark for two days.
Milk curdles when casein clumps together in an acidic environment.
